own.title: Book your appointment
own.intro: Choose a date and time that suits you. We will confirm your slot on WhatsApp or by phone.
own.fee_note: Fees are indicative. Your slot is confirmed once payment is received or the clinic confirms on WhatsApp.
own.notes_placeholder: Anything you would like us to know before the visit (optional, no medical details needed).
own.success_message: Thank you. Our team will confirm your appointment shortly. You can also send the details to us on WhatsApp right now.
own.terms_text: I agree to be contacted by the clinic to confirm this appointment and accept the privacy policy.

payments.title: Pay to confirm your slot
payments.intro: Choose any option below. After paying, tap “I have paid” so we can match your payment to your booking.
